newsitem.title: USA: YPF seeks buyers for mid-Dec Escalante crude.
newsitem.headline: YPF seeks buyers for mid-Dec Escalante crude.

text.p: Argentine YPF is selling 380,000 barrels of Escalante crude for December 16-17, trade sources said Thursday.
YPF is asking a price around January West Texas Intermediate minus $3 a barrel fob, but one trader said the price was "very aggressive."
The company previously offered a cargo for late November at WTI minus $3.05 fob.
Former buyers include Brazilian state oil company Petrobras, Exxon and Argentine Interpetrol.
Elsewhere, Total sold 550,000 bbls of Cusiana for more than February WTI plus 35 cts fob for mid-December, around the premium at which it was last sold.
